actionsHelp.backup: Ask the agent to take a recovery point using the target's configured snapshot and object-store providers.
actionsHelp.collectLogs: Pull recent server logs from the host into the controller so they appear on the Logs tab.
actionsHelp.collectStatus: Ask the agent to report the target's live status. Runtime usage adds per-container resource figures at the cost of a slower probe.
actionsHelp.enroll: Issue a single-use enrollment token and connect a deploy agent. Until an agent enrolls, operations stay queued with nothing to run them.
actionsHelp.preflight: Check the host against the registered revision without changing anything.
actionsHelp.rollback: Return to the release the agent recorded before the current one. Requires an admin lease.
actionsHelp.rollbackUnavailable: No release has been deployed to this target yet, so there is nothing to roll back to.
actionsHelp.rotateKey: Switch to a pre-provisioned key version. Requires an admin lease.
actionsHelp.upgrade: Deploy new immutable image digests at the target's current configuration revision.

backups.description: Recovery points the agent has taken for this target, newest first.
backups.empty: Take a backup to create the first recovery point.

confirm.restore: Restoring overwrites the live data on {label} with this recovery point. A short-lived, user-bound admin lease is requested and the operation is recorded in the audit log.
confirm.rollback: This returns {label} to the release the agent recorded before the current one. A short-lived, user-bound admin lease is requested and the operation is recorded in the audit log.
confirm.rotate-key: This re-keys {label} to the selected pre-provisioned key version. A short-lived, user-bound admin lease is requested and the operation is recorded in the audit log.
confirm.title: Confirm protected server operation

connection.browserTransport: This browser can only reach a controller that returns CORS headers. Run Cognia as the desktop or mobile app to connect to a self-hosted controller directly.
connection.controllerUrlHelp: The controller's public base URL. HTTPS is required outside loopback development.
connection.description: Connect to the cloud-neutral Operations Controller that owns your deployment targets.
connection.disconnectFailed: Could not disconnect from the Operations Controller
connection.eventsLiveHelp: Operation state changes stream from the controller as they happen.
connection.eventsPolledHelp: This shell cannot hold the controller's event stream open, so operations started here are re-read periodically. Work started on another device appears after a refresh.
connection.failed: Could not connect to the Operations Controller
connection.profileIdHelp: A local name for this connection. It scopes the stored token and the offline cache on this device and is never sent to the controller.
connection.storageNotice: The access token is stored in the OS keyring. Only the controller URL and the profile name are kept in local storage.
connection.title: Connect Operations Controller
connection.tokenNotice: Use a short-lived OIDC token with servers:read. Operate and admin permissions are checked again for every mutation.
connection.unlockAccount: Unlock the active account before connecting to a server target.

urlProblem.insecure: Use https://, or http:// only for a loopback controller.
urlProblem.invalid: Enter a full URL, including the scheme.

description: Deploy, observe, back up, restore, and secure Compose or Kubernetes targets from one cloud-neutral workspace.

detail.missingDescription: This target is not in the connected controller's fleet. It may have been removed, or it belongs to another tenant.

enroll.agentIdHelp: Identifies this host to the controller. Use a distinct id per machine serving the target.
enroll.connected: {label} is online — the agent connected and can now run operations.
enroll.description: A registered target only becomes executable once a deploy agent enrolls against it and dials the controller.
enroll.failed: Could not issue an enrollment token
enroll.noTargets: Deploy a target first — an enrollment token is bound to the target the agent will serve.

steps.enroll: Enroll the agent, then remove the staged token
steps.stage-token: Stage the single-use token in an owner-only file

enroll.title: Connect a deploy agent
enroll.waiting: Waiting for the agent's first heartbeat…

errors.authenticationRequired: Your OIDC session is missing or expired. Sign in again and reconnect.
errors.cancel: The operation could not be cancelled
errors.insufficientScope: This token does not carry the scope this operation requires.
errors.networkUnavailable: The controller is unavailable. Check its URL, TLS certificate, and network route.
errors.networkUnavailableBrowser: The controller did not answer. In a browser it must return CORS headers; the desktop and mobile apps reach it directly.
errors.notCancellable: An agent has already claimed this operation, so the controller will not report it as cancelled while it is still running.
errors.operation: The server operation could not be queued
errors.recovery: Retry the operation. If it still fails, inspect the controller audit log with an operator identity.
errors.refresh: Could not refresh the server fleet
errors.targetBusy: Another destructive operation is already running on this target.

fleet.emptyDescription: Deploy a target to describe where Cognia should run, then connect an agent on that host so operations have something to execute them.
fleet.noMatchDescription: No server currently reports this health state.

logs.description: Log lines the agent has shipped to the controller.
logs.empty: Run “Collect logs” to pull recent lines from the host.

operations.cancelConfirmDescription: The controller marks this operation cancelled so no agent can claim it. Nothing on the host has changed yet.
operations.cancelHint: Still queued — no agent has claimed it yet.
operations.cancelUnavailable: An agent has claimed this operation, so it can no longer be cancelled from here.
operations.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
operations.emptyDescription: Operations queued against this fleet appear here, including work started from another device.
operations.timelineEmpty: The controller has not recorded a state change for this operation yet.
operations.timelineFailed: The state-change trail could not be loaded.
operations.title: Operations

preview.notice: Rendered locally for review. The agent renders its own copy from the registered target at deploy time.
preview.title: Rendered deployment
preview.unavailable: This target cannot be rendered yet

title: Servers

upgrade.description: Deploy new images at this target's current configuration revision. The target itself is unchanged.
upgrade.digestNotice: Use immutable sha256 digests. A mutable tag deploys but fails production certification.
upgrade.title: Upgrade release

wizard.certificationHelp: This target is valid and will deploy. It would not pass production certification as configured:
wizard.credentialsNotice: Only credential references are stored. Cloud keys, kubeconfig files, SSH keys, object-store secrets, and enrollment tokens never enter this configuration or the browser cache.
wizard.description: Describe a versioned DeploymentTarget. Provider presets are normalized to the same cloud-neutral contract.
wizard.identityHelp: The OIDC issuer the deployed server trusts, and the scopes it requires. These are the deployment's own identity settings, not the ones this app connected with.
wizard.imagesHelp: Pin every image to an immutable sha256 digest. These are the images the first deploy will run.
wizard.label: Display label
wizard.objectStorePathStyleHelp: Enable for S3-compatible services that require the bucket name in the URL path.
wizard.providerCredentialsRequired: Complete the required provider credential references before deploying.
wizard.title: Deploy a server target
